SELECT COLUMN_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'BNKM' AND TABLE_NAME ='corecustomeraccountrelatedlimitliability'

--1 CHECK DUPLICATE
SELECT CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, PeriodStartTimestamp, LimitB2KId,SOURCESYSTEMCODE, count(1)
FROM bnkm.corecustomeraccountrelatedlimitliability -- WHERE CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = ''
GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, PeriodStartTimestamp, LimitB2KId, SOURCESYSTEMCODE
HAVING count(1) > 1
--
SELECT * FROM bnkm.corecustomeraccountrelatedlimitliability WHERE CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = ''

--2 TAGGED DUPLICATE
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, PeriodStartTimestamp, LimitB2KId, SOURCESYSTEMCODE ORDER BY PeriodEndTimestamp DESC, INSERTDTTM DESC ) RN , --define PKs in partition by
* 
INTO bnkm.corecustomeraccountrelatedlimitliability_WITH_DUP_20230503  --Name of backup table to store duplicate records
FROM bnkm.corecustomeraccountrelatedlimitliability; --Target table to remove duplicate
--
SELECT * FROM bnkm.corecustomeraccountrelatedlimitliability_WITH_DUP_20230503 WHERE CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = '' ORDER BY RN

--3 CHECK COUNT MAIN AND BU TABLE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bnkm.corecustomeraccountrelatedlimitliability_WITH_DUP_20230503
8386616
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bnkm.corecustomeraccountrelatedlimitliability
8386616

--4 CLEAN DUP
TRUNCATE TABLE bnkm.corecustomeraccountrelatedlimitliability; -- Truncate target table to remove duplicate

--5 INSERT BACK UNIQUE RECORDS ONLY
INSERT INTO bnkm.corecustomeraccountrelatedlimitliability --Target table to remove duplicate
SELECT  
CustomerAccountId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,LimitB2KId
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceSystemCode
,TaskRunId
,WorkFlowId
,InsertDttm
FROM bnkm.corecustomeraccountrelatedlimitliability_WITH_DUP_20230503 -- Name of backup table to store duplicate records
WHERE RN = 1;
